# has signature

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSignature`](gmeow-hasSignature.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSignature>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an entity, attestation, or artifact to a cryptographic signature over it. Domain-free (universal spine): anything may carry a signature. The message-specific convenience property with domain [`gmeow:Message`](../classes/gmeow-Message.md) lives in the messaging-trust module as a historical subproperty.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasSignature`](gmeow-hasSignature.md) from `?` to [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach a [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md) to anything that is signed — an attestation, its carrier artifact, a release, a message — the universal domain-free signature spine.

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating the presence of a signature as proof the signed claim is true — a valid signature proves integrity and signer key control only, not correctness (module boundaries); the truth question stays on the claim's standpoint.

### How to use

- Reference a [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md) individual carrying [`gmeow:signedBy`](gmeow-signedBy.md) / [`gmeow:signingKey`](gmeow-signingKey.md) / [`gmeow:signatureAlgorithm`](gmeow-signatureAlgorithm.md); the actual signature check is a [`gmeow:VerificationActivity`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationActivity.md) in the solver layer, recorded as a [`gmeow:VerificationResult`](../classes/gmeow-VerificationResult.md), never asserted as truth.
